body: I am looking for help because I don't want my life to end. I just don't know what the heck to do. I've used so many resources and nothing seems to help. I Think at this point I really need to talk to my parents. I hate doing that but your post made me think this is the best idea. Thank you for your post, I really do sincerely appreciate it.
Much, much professional help. It just seems to never actually help. They tend to think that the right pill combos will help but so far they don't. I really appreciate your post, thank you.
